# Nehemiah Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 471v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_006_page_001.jpg

---

**6:1** And-it-was when it-was-heard [nishma] by-Sanvallat and-Toviyah and-Geshem the-Aravi and-the-rest of-our-enemies that I-had-built [baniti] the-wall and-no-breach [perets] was-left [lo notar] in-it — though [gam] until that-time I-had-not set-up [lo he'emadeti] doors [delatot] in-the-gates —

**6:2** and-Sanvallat and-Geshem sent [va-yishlach] to-me, saying, "Come [lekhah], let-us-meet-together [ve-niva'adah yachdav] in-one-of the-villages [ba-kefirim] in-the-valley [be-viq'at] of-Ono." And-they were-planning [choshevim] to-do [la'asot] to-me evil [ra'ah].

**6:3** And-I-sent to-them messengers [mal'akhim], saying, "A-great work [melakhah gedolah] I am-doing [oseh], and-I-am-not-able [lo ukhal] to-come-down [laredet]. Why should the-work [ha-melakhah] cease [tishbot] while I-leave-it [arpeha] and-come-down to-you?"

**6:4** And-they-sent to-me according-to-this word [ka-davar ha-zeh] four times [arba pe'amim], and-I-answered them according-to-this same-way [ka-davar ha-zeh].

**6:5** And-Sanvallat sent to-me according-to-this word his-servant [na'aro] a-fifth time [pa'am chamishit] with-an-open [petuchah] letter [iggeret] in-his-hand.

**6:6** Written [katuv] in-it: "Among the-nations [ba-goyim] it-is-heard [nishma], and-Gashmu says, [that] you and-the-Yehudim are-planning [choshevim] to-rebel [limrod]; therefore [al ken] you are-building [boneh] the-wall, and-you are-becoming [hoveh] their-king [le-melekh], according-to-these words [ka-devarim ha-eleh].

**6:7** And-also prophets [nevi'im] you-have-set-up [he'emadta] to-proclaim [liqro] concerning-you in-Yerushalayim, saying, 'A-king [melekh] in-Yehudah!' And-now it-will-be-heard [yishama] by-the-king according-to-these words. So-now come [lekhah], and-let-us-take-counsel [ve-niva'atsah] together."

**6:8** And-I-sent to-him, saying, "It-has-not-been [lo nihyah] according-to-these things [ka-devarim ha-eleh] which you are-saying, for from-your-own-heart [mi-libbkha] you are-inventing-them [bode otam]."

**6:9** For all-of-them were-trying-to-frighten-us [meyar'im otanu], saying, "Their-hands [yedeyhem] will-drop [yirpu] from the-work and-it-will-not be-done [lo te'aseh]." And-now, strengthen [chazzaq] my-hands [yadai].

**6:10** And-I came to the-house of-Shemayah son of-Delayah son of-Meheytav'el, and-he [was] shut-in [atsor]. And-he-said, "Let-us-meet [nivva'ed] at-the-house of-God [beyt ha-Elohim], inside [el tokh] the-temple [ha-heykhal], and-let-us-close [ve-nisgerah] the-doors of-the-temple, for they-are-coming [ba'im] to-kill-you [le-horgekha], and-at-night [va-laylah] they-are-coming to-kill-you."

**6:11** And-I-said, "Should-a-man [ha-ish] like-me [kamoni] flee [yivrach]? And-who like-me [u-mi khamoni] who could-enter [yavo] the-temple [ha-heykhal] and-live [va-chay]? I-will-not enter [lo avo]."

**6:12** And-I-recognized [va-akkirah], and-behold, God had-not sent-him [lo shelachaho], for the-prophecy [ha-nevu'ah] he-spoke [dibber] concerning-me — Toviyah and-Sanvallat had-hired-him [sekharuhu].

**6:13** For-this-reason [le-ma'an] he-was-hired [sakur], so-that I-would-fear [ira] and-do so [ve-e'eseh khen] and-sin [ve-chatati], and-it-would-be for-them a-bad-name [le-shem ra], so-that they-could-reproach-me [le-ma'an yecherephuni].

**6:14** Remember [zokhrah], my-God, Toviyah and-Sanvallat according-to-these their-deeds [ma'asav], and-also Noadyah the-prophetess [ha-nevi'ah] and-the-rest of-the-prophets who-were-trying-to-frighten-me [meyar'im oti].

**6:15** And-the-wall was-completed [va-tishlam ha-chomah] on-the-twenty-fifth of-Elul, in-fifty-two days [ba-chamishim u-shnayyim yom].

**6:16** And-it-was when all our-enemies heard and-all the-nations [ha-goyim] that-were around-us saw, they-fell [va-yippelu] greatly [me'od] in-their-own-eyes [be-eyneyhem], and-they-knew [va-yede'u] that from our-God [me-et Elohenu] this-work [ha-melakhah ha-zot] was-done [ne'estah].

**6:17** Also in-those days the-nobles of-Yehudah were-multiplying [marbim] their-letters [iggeroteyhem] going [holkhot] to-Toviyah, and-those of-Toviyah were-coming to-them.

**6:18** For many [rabbim] in-Yehudah were-sworn [ba'aley shevu'ah] to-him, for he was son-in-law [chatan] of-Shekhanyah son of-Arach, and-Yehochanan his-son had-taken the-daughter of-Meshullam son of-Berekhyah.

**6:19** Also his-good-deeds [tovotav] they were-telling [omrim] before-me, and-my-words [devaray] they were-taking-out [motsi'im] to-him. Letters Toviyah sent to-frighten-me [le-yare'eni].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **6:5 "open letter"** — An unsealed letter was a deliberate breach of protocol, designed to make its accusations public and spread rumors widely.
2. **6:6 "Gashmu"** — An Arabized form of "Geshem," possibly reflecting the actual pronunciation or adding a note of sarcasm in the quotation.
3. **6:11 "who like me could enter the temple and live?"** — Nehemiah, as a layman, recognized that entering the inner temple would violate Mosaic law; the suggestion was a trap designed to make him sin.
4. **6:15 "fifty-two days"** — The remarkably short construction period was itself a testimony to divine enablement, as recognized even by the surrounding nations (v. 16).

*— EMET*
